_lagprof_notes: Sent to the Kibana role API (PUT /api/security/role/lagprof-workflow). Keys starting with _lagprof are removed before sending.
The installer replaces __SPACES__ with ["*"] for the all-spaces workflow, or ["<space id>"] for a per-space copy.
Confirmed on 9.5.6: a workflow's scheduled runs use the identity of the account that last saved it; manual runs use whoever starts them. This role is enough for a full run.

So give this role to a dedicated user, create an API key as that user, and set LAGPROF_WORKFLOW_API_KEY so the installer saves the workflow with it. That's why the role can create and update workflows (not delete).
Feature IDs (GET /api/features on 9.5.6): securitySolutionRulesV4 and workflowsManagement. siemV2 is outdated; Kibana accepts it silently.
manage_own_api_key lets the dedicated user create the API key that owns the workflow. It covers only that user's own keys.
